title: The explanation fits too well
lines: Coherence Pressure proposes a name for the pull to connect things before the evidence is there.
It begins with a child who wants an unwanted app removed but keeps watching short videos.

emotionalPlan.purpose: Make overconfident synthesis recognizable. Name the book and its concrete starting case.
voiceDirections: Explain the proposed idea in a warm, ordinary voice; emphasize the concrete choice the listener can inspect, without announcing a proven breakthrough.
Explain the proposed idea in a warm, ordinary voice; emphasize the concrete choice the listener can inspect, without announcing a proven breakthrough.

sentencePerformance.text: Coherence Pressure proposes a name for the pull to connect things before the evidence is there.
sentencePerformance.viewerResponse: Feel the attraction of a neat explanation and a reason to pause.
sentencePerformance.voiceDirection: Conversational and immediately clear; give light emphasis to “seem to share one cause”. Sound interested in the question, not as if revealing a secret.
sentencePerformance.gesture: Parent: curious face (raised brows, relaxed mouth), gaze to the phone, open questioning hand held toward the devices; the dashed bridge appears only after.

sentencePerformance.text: It begins with a child who wants an unwanted app removed but keeps watching short videos.

sentencePerformance.gesture: Parent: calm face, palm-up inviting hand toward the child. Child: frowning push-away hand at the app, then head and gaze turn to the phone, a smile and a step toward it, reaching for the videos.

visual.meaning: A parent stands by a family table with a tablet (an unwanted app with a removal cross) and a phone streaming short videos.
